title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: One less way to lose the extension
summary: One more way to lose the whole extension through a settings file, closed.

highlights.title: Exclusion Setting Written As A String
highlights.description: Writing kotlinJump.excludePatterns as a plain string instead of a list made activation fail, taking every feature with it. A lone string now counts as the single pattern it is, and any other shape is ignored rather than fatal.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Writing kotlinJump.excludePatterns as a plain string instead of a list stopped the extension from loading. The value is read during activation, and reading it as a list failed there, so every feature went away at once with nothing to see but the extension host log. A lone string is now read as the single pattern it obviously is, and a value of any other shape is ignored instead of being fatal. This completes the previous release, which had learned to skip an empty entry inside the list but still assumed the setting itself was one.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No new commands or settings in this release.
